# OniBlog

OniBlog is a high-performance, statically-generated digital workspace and blog built with Vite, React, and Markdown. It focuses on modern web development, minimalist UI/UX design, and AI-assisted programming.

## Overview
- **Main Skills**: Java, ReactJS, Kubernetes, Docker, Node.js, Golang, Mobile Development.
- **Hobbies**: FPV Drones, Nintendo Switch 2, PC & Retro Gaming.
- **About/Profile Page**: Hosted on path `/kodama/`

## Main Features
- Dynamic search of all posts and tags.
- Category tabs filtering.
- Pastel Cozy Lavender / Periwinkle theme supporting both light and dark modes.

## Primary Resources

- [Homepage](/) - The main landing page listing posts, categories, and tags.
- [About Page](/kodama/) - Detailed developer profile and background.
- [RSS Feed](/rss.xml) - RSS syndication feed for the blog.
